notes: Fixes the reported `ImportError: cannot import name 'CachedRepoTreeNotFoundError' from 'huggingface_hub.errors'`. The compatibility shim now also defines `CachedRepoTreeNotFoundError` in BOTH `huggingface_hub` and `huggingface_hub.errors`. The class subclasses the local `HfHubHTTPError`/`HFHubError` base (if present) plus `OSError`, so any downstream `except` clause keeps working; if a newer huggingface_hub already ships a real class the shim reuses it. `_ensure_hf_compat()` is called at module import time AND re-asserted immediately before `from diffusers import ...` in `run`, in case torch/hub loading replaced or reloaded the modules. The `get_cached_repo_tree` shim (implemented over local `scan_cache_dir`, never touching the network) plus the inert DDUF placeholders are still installed, and all shims are propagated to any already-imported `huggingface_hub.*` submodule. The shim only affects import resolution: it never influences the model, the Canny(100,200) conditioning, sampling parameters (12 steps / guidance 7.5 / conditioning_scale 1.0), or output bytes. On a container where diffusers and huggingface_hub already match, `_ensure_hf_compat()` is a no-op. All other contract behavior is unchanged: `doctor --input input` inspects files/deps without loading models (exit 78 if anything is missing, 0 otherwise); `run` requires CUDA, loads sd-controlnet-canny + SD1.5 in fp16, writes control/<id>.png, images/<id>.png, index.jsonl and run.json with input hashes, deterministic replayable seeds, device and synchronized timings, and accepts any new input directory with its own requests.jsonl. The mask field remains ignored and no reference-large claim is made.
